title: CoordinationCommand
description: A coordination instruction issued by the NetworkBrain to a Site Agent.

type.description: The type of coordination action to execute.

target_site_id.description: The site that should execute this command.

risk_score.description: Risk score that triggered this command.

requires_human_approval.description: If true, the target agent must obtain human approval before executing.

issued_at.description: Unix epoch timestamp when this command was issued.

expires_at.description: Unix epoch timestamp after which this command should be discarded if unexecuted.
